reviewed_additions.tracked-link-tool: En **Crear un enlace corto**, pega la URL de destino y selecciona **Agregar enlace corto**.
reviewed_additions.personalization-tool: Abre **Etiquetas** con el botón de llaves y selecciona la propiedad que quieres insertar, como `name`.
reviewed_additions.test-destination: Para una prueba SMS, en **Enviar mensaje a este número**, elige el país e ingresa un número que controles.

reviewed_additions.tracked-link-tool: In **Create a shortlink**, paste the destination URL and select **Add short link**.
reviewed_additions.personalization-tool: Open **Tags** with the braces button and select the property you want to insert, such as `name`.
reviewed_additions.test-destination: For an SMS test, in **Send message to this number**, choose the country and enter a number you control.

checks.evidence: Link toolbar renders Compose::LinkFormComponent with informational.add_short_link title, URL input and actions.add_short_link submit. Exact titles: Crear un enlace corto / Create a shortlink. Exact buttons: Agregar enlace corto / Add short link.

Tags toolbar uses the brackets icon, whose SVG draws paired braces, and localized title Etiquetas / Tags. Clicking a tag dispatches insertTag with its data-tag value. Default tags include Liquid::Contact::TAGS, which explicitly contains name.

Campaign test form title is Enviar mensaje a este número / Send message to this number and renders UI::Input::Phone. Its JS initializes intl-tel-input and handles country selector/change events; the component exposes the telephone entry field. No test message was sent.
